purpose: Define the permitted MealUp Toys 3D range without allowing progressive drift toward food photography.
target: clean color blocks and gentle shading
failIf: candidate is more photorealistic than the r4 maximum-realism boundary
visible meat fibers pores wrinkles or irregular photographic micro-texture dominate
grain or high-frequency surface detail weakens mobile clarity
hard photographic grill crust specular noise or naturalistic roughness replaces toy simplification
food and vessel appear to belong to different rendering styles
qaRule: Compare every candidate with the ideal center and the maximum-realism boundary. Passing technical resolution does not override perceptual grain or style drift.
